### Day 286: Acts 23:23–35
Author: Beth Moore  
Site: Crosswalk  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-286-acts-23-2335.html  
Passage: Acts 23:23-35  
Points:
- God uses creative and unexpected means, including a Roman cavalry escort, to deliver His servants.
- Intercessory prayer is a powerful instrument that God uses in bringing about rescue and sustaining strength.
- Although the Lord needs no help, He graciously invites believers to share in His work through prayer.
- Praying for one another allows us to share in the joy and thanksgiving when deliverance arrives.
- Paul traveled safely to Caesarea supported not only by soldiers, but by the prayers of the saints.
